document: Certificate or attestation issued to a person (training, qualification, membership), not a tax authority document
glossary: Document type: Certificate or attestation issued to a person (training, qualification, membership), not a tax authority document. Field names are English identifiers; the document text is verbatim, usually Hungarian.

field_specs.document_title: the document title as printed on the document (Az okirat cime/megnevezese, ahogy a dokumentumon szerepel (pl. Diploma, Erkolcsi bizonyitvany, Certificate of Completion))
field_specs.holder_name: the holder name as printed on the document (Akinek az okiratot kiallitottak (nev))
field_specs.issuer: the issuer as printed on the document (Kiallito intezmeny/szervezet neve)
field_specs.issue_date: the issue date as printed on the document (Kiallitas datuma, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD)
field_specs.certificate_type: the certificate type as printed on the document (Tipus-besorolas: diploma | bizonyitvany | tanusitvany | igazolas | nyelvvizsga | erkolcsi_bizonyitvany | egyeb)
field_specs.valid_until: the valid until as printed on the document (Ervenyesseg vege, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD, ha szerepel; kulonben null)
field_specs.registration_number: the registration number as printed on the document (Okirat-/torzslap-/anyakonyvi szam, ha szerepel)
